registration_stage: agent freeze before target implementation and model trials
target_mechanism: stateful absolute stock snapshots; event identity, per-entity revision order, process restart
independence_scope: new synthetic mechanism and data generator; same project authorship, no independently sampled real organizations
primary_target_outcome: exact final stock for all entities and zero stale or duplicate writes in every phase, across all registered seeds
hypotheses: frozen source-specialized instructions may fail to transfer to a different mechanism
source revision may help or hurt transfer relative to ancestor
neutral instructions control for interface learnability and specialization
analysis: raw paired within-target contrasts; no cross-domain composite score, no p-values from workload seeds
failure_policy: retain every episode and violation; distinguish policy-schema rejection, transport failure and semantic outcome failure; no selecting best retries
freeze_policy: no agent source changes; all six development sessions finish and policies freeze before any held-out evaluations; no final evaluation feedback for development
